result.name: huntbase-hub
result.title: Huntbase Hub
result.desc:
Ingest open threat hunts from the Huntbase Hub (https://hub.huntbase.io) as
plan:procedure graphs, with their queries, ATT&CK techniques, CVEs and
source reports.

modules.name: huntbase.hub

commands.name: huntbase.hub.sync

cmdargs.help: Ignore the sync cursor and re-ingest every hunt.
Stop after this many hunts (0 = no limit).

commands.name: huntbase.hub.import
commands.desc:
Ingest one or more hunts from the Huntbase Hub by slug and yield the procedures.

Example:
  huntbase.hub.import activemq-lateral-movement-lockbit

cmdargs.help: Hub hunt slugs (the last path segment of a hunt URL).
